test_title: PYST 44: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following best reflects Judicial Activism?

options.text: Voluntary interference by the judiciary in public interest

solution:
The correct answer is __**Voluntary interference by the judiciary in public interest**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Judicial Activism** refers to the proactive role played by the judiciary in safeguarding the rights of citizens and ensuring justice, particularly in cases where legislative and executive actions are inadequate.
 
• It involves the **voluntary interference** by the judiciary in matters of public interest, often through Public Interest Litigation (PIL), where courts address societal issues like corruption, environmental protection, and human rights violations.
 
• Unlike passive interpretation, judicial activism allows the judiciary to **expand the scope of laws** to address complex and evolving societal needs.
 
• Examples of judicial activism include the **Vishakha Guidelines** for preventing sexual harassment at the workplace and the recognition of environmental rights as part of the Right to Life under **Article 21** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Judicial activism is seen as a mechanism to uphold **constitutional principles** and prevent the misuse of power by other branches
